summary: Practise finance prompts, output checks and AI governance controls. Explore the course and strengthen your finance team's review process.
lede: Generative AI for finance training helps finance leaders, FP&A managers and control specialists assess and govern AI-assisted workflows. Participants practise designing prompts for variance narratives, checking generated calculations and financial-model outputs in Excel, and documenting review evidence. They also map data safeguards and risks using the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, with an applied overview of ISO/IEC 42001, to support human review and traceable finance decisions.
audienceIntro: This programme suits finance professionals who evaluate, approve, control or operate AI-assisted work. It is designed for roles that need to balance useful automation with reliable financial evidence and data safeguards.
modules: NIST AI RMF for Finance Risk
Treasury Workflow Review with NIST AI RMF
prerequisites: Working knowledge of at least one finance workflow, such as budgeting, financial reporting, audit, treasury or financial control. No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with spreadsheet-based finance work is useful for the Excel exercises.
